about-me.description:
Hi, I'm Demis. I'm passionate about software development because I love the mix of creativity and logical thinking. Every project is a new opportunity to turn complex problems into clear and efficient solutions. My inspiration comes from constantly learning and refining my code to make it more elegant step by step. 

 Let's bring ideas to life and create something remarkable together!

join.title: Join
join.description: Task manager inspired by the Kanban System. Create and organize tasks using drag and drop functions, assign users and categories.
join.implementation: As part of a team, I developed a task manager in the Kanban style using Angular, TypeScript, and Firebase. I implemented the drag-and-drop functionality, user management, and structured task organization. This project demonstrates my ability to work efficiently both independently and as part of a team.

epl.title: El Pollo Loco
epl.description: Jump, run and throw game based on object-oriented approach. Help Pepe to find coins and tabasco salsa to fight against the crazy hen.
epl.implementation: I developed a jump-and-run game with throwing mechanics based on an object-oriented approach. I implemented the game logic in JavaScript, created animations, and designed the responsive layout using HTML and CSS. This project highlights my ability to develop complex logic and apply it creatively.

pokedex.title: Pokédex
pokedex.description: This app is a Pokédex - a digital encyclopedia from the Pokémon universe that provides detailed information about different Pokémon, including their abilities, types, and evolutions.
pokedex.implementation: I developed a Pokédex app that provides detailed information about different Pokémon, including their abilities, types, and evolutions. I used an external Pokémon API to fetch data dynamically. The data was processed using JavaScript, and the presentation was built with HTML and CSS. This project demonstrates my ability to structure API data effectively and design user-friendly interfaces.
